title: land names git rebase origin/main, not git merge --ff-only, for a dirty orchestrator checkout that holds local commits
goal: A dirty checkout with commits beyond its upstream is told git rebase origin/main once the tree is clean, as gate behind-main of ST-22oykpr5 answered

run:
import sys, subprocess, tempfile, os
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def sh(cwd, *a):
    subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@example.com'] + list(a), cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True)
origin = os.path.join(d, 'origin.git')
sh(d, 'init', '-q', '--bare', '-b', 'main', origin)
a = os.path.join(d, 'a')
sh(d, 'clone', '-q', origin, a)
open(os.path.join(a, 'f.txt'), 'w').write('1')
sh(a, 'add', '.'); sh(a, 'commit', '-qm', 'one'); sh(a, 'push', '-q', 'origin', 'HEAD:main')
b = os.path.join(d, 'b')
sh(d, 'clone', '-q', origin, b)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(b, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
open(os.path.join(b, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', 'ST-aaaaaaaa.json'), 'w').write('x')
sh(b, 'add', '.'); sh(b, 'commit', '-qm', 'local item')
open(os.path.join(a, 'g.txt'), 'w').write('2')
sh(a, 'add', '.'); sh(a, 'commit', '-qm', 'two'); sh(a, 'push', '-q', 'origin', 'HEAD:main')
sh(b, 'fetch', '-q', 'origin')
open(os.path.join(b, 'dirty.txt'), 'w').write('d')
out = []
bl_land.say = lambda s='': out.append(s)
bl_land.fast_forward_start(b, 'origin', 'refs/heads/main', 'origin/main')
text = ' '.join(out)
print(text)
sys.exit(0 if 'git rebase origin/main' in text and 'merge --ff-only' not in text else 1)
